title: 2011 members' capital: opening balance to closing balance
summary: $6,138,252 opening capital plus $5,469,261 net income less $2,859,153 aggregate distributions equals $8,748,360 closing capital.
limitation: This accepted arithmetic bridge is firm-level. It does not identify distribution recipients or establish personal income or receipts.
